body.zh: 导入或打开一篇论文，拆成问题、方法、结果、局限，以及和你的研究有什么关系。
body.en: Open a paper and break it into question, method, results, limits and relevance to your work.

prompt.en: Help me read this paper closely.

title.zh: 把几篇文献做成对比表

body.zh: 选几篇资料，按问题、方法、数据、结果、局限做成对比表，找出研究空白。
body.en: Compare several papers by question, method, data, results and limits, and spot the gaps.

prompt.zh: 把我选的几篇文献做成对比表。
prompt.en: Compare the papers I select in an evidence matrix.

body.zh: 按“进展、结果、问题、需要导师决定的事”搭好组会汇报。
body.en: Build a group-meeting deck: progress, results, problems and decisions you need.
